name: The Tollhouse
description: The Red Company's one open door (factions Phase 4): a bar across the High Road's first climb where the Company talks before it takes. Weight 0 — the authored-sites law pins it to its one cell; the broker is untargetable, the guards invulnerable, and nobody here draws first. The closed throat still rules: spill Company blood and only the blood-price reopens the conversation.
